children: American Eagle Outfitters reported results for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, with revenue of $1.38B and diluted EPS of $0.79, reflecting year‑over‑year revenue growth and a sizable increase in profit compared with the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $1.38B, compared with $1.284B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 8%.
Net income was $134.1M, compared with $77.6M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 73%.
Diluted EPS was $0.79, compared with $0.45 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 75%.
Total net revenue rose 8% for the 13‑week period and 9% for the 26‑week period, led by digital growth of 20% (13 weeks) and 17% (26 weeks).
Digital outperformance delivered mid‑single digit gains in average transaction value and traffic, helping offset weaker in‑store traffic.
Aerie was the primary growth driver, with revenue up 25% and comparable sales up 19% for the 13‑week period (29% revenue growth and 22% comp sales for 26 weeks).
The company recognized a $192M IEEPA tariff refund benefit, which supported margin expansion and operational cash flow during the period.
